label: End-of-episode D1 after an a2 choice that rarely transitioned to S1
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only in the last 10 trials of an episode (ep_trial 90-99; zero activity before trial 90; all activity is in the lowest value-head bin, which matches the end-of-episode drop in value). Within that window it is almost entirely conditioned on the previous trial being a2 with a rare transition to S1 (prev_action==2 & prev_common==0 holds 93% of mass); it essentially never fires after a1 or after a common transition. Restricting to ep_trial>=95 gives dev P=0.64 R=0.76 F1=0.70, mass recall 0.85; ep_trial>=90 gives R=0.92 but P=0.36. It is enriched when the episode started with S1 good (92% of mass) and when the previous outcome was unrewarded (81% of mass); adding start_high raises precision to 0.82 at a cost in recall. Adding the agent upcoming choice action==2 (stay with a2, legitimately computed) gives F1 0.73; I recorded the simpler observed-history version. Strong lift on d1_err trials (55x) but these are a small share of mass. Does not fire at GO or D2. Missed activations are mostly rel -3 D1 steps where prev trial is outside the window (prev_common unknown). All variables used are observed.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 35 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (+4.10), phase=D1 & ep_dec=9 (+3.94), phase=D1 & last=a2 S1 r (+2.86), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+2.73), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 2 (9 = most a1) (+2.67), ep_dec=9 (+2.03). Lower it: action=1 (-2.56), rel=1 (-2.39), prev_state=2 (-2.08), choice_bin=decile 6 (9 = most a1) (-1.95).
